title: CMP: Robust Whole-Body Tracking for Loco-Manipulation via Competence Manifold Projection
abstract: arXiv:2604.07457v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While decoupled control schemes for legged mobile manipulators have shown robustness, learning holistic whole-body control policies for tracking global end-effector poses remains fragile against Out-of-Distribution (OOD) inputs induced by sensor noise or infeasible user commands. To improve robustness against these perturbations without sacrificing task performance and continuity, we propose Competence Manifold Projection (CMP). Specifically, we utilize a Frame-Wise Safety Scheme that transforms the infinite-horizon safety constraint into a computationally efficient single-step manifold inclusion. To instantiate this competence manifold, we employ a Lower-Bounded Safety Estimator that distinguishes unmastered intentions from the training distribution. We then introduce an Isomorphic Latent Space (ILS) that aligns manifold geometry with safety probability, enabling efficient O(1) seamless defense against arbitrary OOD intents. E

translated_title: CMP：基于能力流形投影的移动操作鲁棒全身跟踪
translated_abstract: 尽管针对腿式移动操作机器人的解耦控制方案已经展现出了鲁棒性，但用于跟踪全局末端执行器位姿的整体全身控制策略学习，在面对由传感器噪声或不可行用户指令引起的分布外（OOD）输入时仍然脆弱。为了在不牺牲任务性能和连续性的前提下提高对这些扰动的鲁棒性，我们提出了能力流形投影（CMP）。具体而言，我们利用一种逐帧安全方案，将无限时域的安全约束转化为计算高效的单步流形包含问题。为了实例化这一能力流形，我们采用了一种下界安全估计器，用于从训练分布中区分出尚未掌握的意图。随后，我们引入了同构潜在空间（ILS），将流形几何与安全概率对齐，从而能够以O(1)的计算效率对任意OOD意图实现无缝防御。
tldr: 提出能力流形投影（CMP）框架，通过逐帧安全方案、下界安全估计器和同构潜在空间，以O(1)的高效计算实现对腿式移动操作机器人全身控制中分布外输入的鲁棒防御，同时不牺牲任务性能与连续性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Competence Manifold Projection (CMP), a framework that combines a frame-wise safety scheme, a lower-bounded safety estimator, and an isomorphic latent space to achieve efficient O(1) robust defense against out-of-distribution inputs in whole-body loco-manipulation tracking without sacrificing task performance or continuity.
